name: Rings (2 inch)
description: These sturdy 2 inch rings are the perfect hardware addition to your amigurumi and crochet accessory projects. name: Rings (2.5 inch)

name: Rings (4 inch)
description: When your crochet project calls for something bold and sturdy, these 4 inch rings deliver. Perfect for attaching large bag handles, creating statement bag hardware, or adding oversized decorative loops to your handmade pieces. Strong, smooth, and built to hold up to everyday use beautifully.

name: Crochet Hook Set (9 hooks)
description: Take your crochet game to the next level with this complete 9-piece hook set. Designed for crafters of all skill levels, these ergonomic hooks come in sizes ranging from 2mm to 6mm, covering everything from delicate lace work to chunky yarn projects. The soft, non-slip rubber handles keep your hands comfortable through even the longest crochet sessions, while the smooth aluminum tips glide through yarn effortlessly without snagging. Color-coded and size-labelled so you always grab the right hook, every time.

name: Crochet Hook Set (5 hooks)
description: Everything you need to get started, all in one place. This handy 5-piece crochet hook set includes the most commonly used sizes, making it perfect for beginners or as a travel-friendly set for crafters on the go. The soft-grip ergonomic handles reduce strain on your fingers and wrists, while the smooth tips ensure clean, consistent stitches every time. Lightweight, compact, and easy to toss into your project bag — your new go-to set for everyday crocheting.

name: U Green Pipe (10 piece)
description: Keep your crochet florals standing tall and looking gorgeous. This set of 10 U-shaped green floral stem pipes are perfect for giving your handmade crochet flowers a natural, lifelike structure. Lightweight yet sturdy, these green stems blend seamlessly with your yarn work and are easy to wrap, stitch around, or insert directly into your crochet flower bases. Whether you're making bouquets, corsages, hair accessories, or decorative arrangements — these stems give your blooms the posture and polish they deserve.

name: Green Pipe (10)
description: Your crochet flowers just got an upgrade. This pack of 10 green floral stem pipes give your handmade crochet blooms a firm, natural-looking stem that holds its shape beautifully. Simply wrap with green yarn or floral tape to blend in perfectly with your flower work. Ideal for creating crochet bouquets, single stem flowers, wreaths, and decorative arrangements. Lightweight, easy to trim to your desired length, and sturdy enough to keep every petal proudly in place.

name: Bag Mesh square
description: The perfect base for your next crochet bag project. This sturdy square mesh panel features an open grid pattern that makes it incredibly easy to work your yarn through, stitch by stitch. It holds its shape beautifully, giving your handmade bags a firm, structured foundation that soft yarn alone can't provide. Great for creating tote bags, clutches, baskets, and decorative pouches with a clean, polished finish that looks like it came straight from a boutique.

name: Plastic Needle (5)
description: No crochet project is truly finished until those yarn ends are neatly woven in — and that's exactly what these large-eye plastic needles are made for. This pack of 5 blunt-tip needles makes threading even the thickest yarn quick and hassle-free. The smooth plastic body glides through your crochet fabric without splitting stitches or snagging. A small tool that makes a big difference in giving your finished pieces that clean, professional look.

name: Plastic Needle (20)
description: Always have a needle ready when you need one. This value pack of 20 large-eye plastic needles is ideal for weaving in yarn ends, seaming crochet pieces together, and adding those finishing touches that make your work look truly polished. The blunt tip protects your stitches while the wide eye accommodates all yarn thicknesses with ease. Perfect for prolific crocheters who always have multiple projects on the go.

name: Plastic Safety Pin
description: A tiny tool that every crocheter needs in their kit. These plastic safety pins are perfect for marking stitches, holding seams together before joining, and keeping track of pattern repeats as you work. Rust-free and smooth, they won't snag or damage your yarn, making them safe to use even on the most delicate crochet projects. Lightweight, reusable, and endlessly handy — once you start using stitch markers, you'll wonder how you ever crocheted without them.

name: Gold Wire
description: Add a touch of glamour to your crochet creations with this fine metallic gold wire. Perfect for weaving into crochet bags, baskets, and accessories to create a shimmering, high-end finish that catches the light beautifully. Flexible enough to work with easily yet firm enough to hold its shape, this wire is a favourite among crochet crafters who love adding decorative details and embellishments to their handmade pieces. Elevate your everyday crochet project into something truly eye-catching.

name: Silver Wire
description: Bring a sleek, modern edge to your handmade crochet pieces with this fine metallic silver wire. Ideal for weaving through crochet bags and accessories to add a subtle shimmer and a stylish, structured detail. Pliable and easy to work with alongside your yarn, it blends seamlessly into your project while adding that extra-special finishing touch. Perfect for crafters who love mixing textures and adding a metallic accent to their crochet work.

name: Bag Mesh Design
description: Craft a show-stopping crochet bag with this beautifully patterned design mesh panel. Featuring an attractive open-weave grid, this mesh is easy to stitch through and gives your finished bag a designer-quality structure and texture. Whether you're making a tote, clutch, or storage basket, this mesh panel does the heavy lifting — keeping your bag firm and shapely while you focus on the fun part: choosing your yarn and stitching your own unique creation.

name: Mini Pliers
description: This set of 3 mini pliers gives you everything you need to handle all the detailed hardware finishing on your crochet bag projects. Use them for opening and closing jump rings, attaching bag clasps and handles, bending wire accents, and securing metal findings with precision and ease. Each plier is lightweight and comfortable in hand, designed for the kind of fiddly, detailed work that fingers alone just can't manage. Keep one at your workstation, one in your project bag, and one as a spare — because once you have them, you'll use them constantly.

name: Punch Needle Set
description: Discover a whole new side of yarn crafting with the punch needle — a beautifully simple tool that creates stunning looped textile art with minimal effort. Push yarn through fabric with a smooth, repetitive motion to build up rich, textured designs perfect for wall hangings, coasters, decorative patches, and embellishments for your crochet projects. The ergonomic handle sits comfortably in your hand for extended crafting, and the smooth metal tip punches cleanly through fabric with every stroke. If you love crochet, you're going to love this.

name: Scissors (small)
description: Every crafter's trusty sidekick. These compact, sharp-bladed scissors are perfect for snipping yarn ends, trimming threads between stitches, and doing all the precise little cuts that keep your crochet work looking neat and tidy. Small enough to tuck into any project bag and always within reach when you need them. A simple tool, but an absolutely essential one for any crocheter who takes pride in their finished work.

name: Scissors (large)
description: When you need a clean cut through multiple strands of yarn or a thick fabric panel, these large craft scissors get the job done effortlessly. The sharp stainless steel blades slice smoothly through yarn, mesh, and fabric without fraying or dragging, while the comfortable grip handles keep your hands happy during longer crafting sessions. A reliable workhorse in any crocheter's toolkit — built for the bigger cuts that smaller scissors just can't handle.
